articles.headline: Islamabad ATC seeks report on failure to produce Imaan, Hadi in security breach case
articles.summary: AI summary: An Islamabad anti-terrorism court asked jail officials to explain why rights lawyers Imaan Mazari and Hadi Ali Chattha were not physically brought to court as ordered, after a jail report blamed a missing police escort; the pair appeared by video link. The court also set aside, as premature, their plea to drop terrorism charges tied to removing security barriers placed for the visiting English cricket team.

articles.headline: India's 'cockroach' movement chief detained ahead of major protest
articles.summary: AI summary: Indian police held Abhijeet Dipke, leader of the satirical Cockroach Janta Party, and two colleagues as they arrived in Delhi for a protest demanding the chief election commissioner's resignation over a contested voter-roll revision, while authorities shut roads, metro stations and trains around the capital. The party claims some 10,000 supporters were detained nationwide, a figure police have not addressed, and the Election Commission denies wrongdoing.

articles.headline: Trump sows doubt on plan to livestream US military execution
articles.summary: AI summary: President Trump signalled that a decision is still pending on whether the December 3 firing-squad execution of 2009 Fort Hood gunman Nidal Hasan will be broadcast live, despite earlier Pentagon statements that it would be. The plan has drawn criticism from lawmakers, Catholic bishops and the UN human rights chief, and it would be the first US military firing-squad execution since 1945.

articles.summary: AI summary: At the Security Council's monthly Yemen session, Pakistan's UN envoy Asim Iftikhar Ahmad pledged support for Saudi Arabia under the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement and condemned Houthi strikes on Saudi airports, power and other infrastructure. He also urged an end to attacks on commercial shipping, backed the UN envoy's mediation, and called for humanitarian access and the release of detained UN and diplomatic staff.

articles.headline: PIA temporarily suspends Riyadh flights, confirms PAA
articles.summary: AI summary: PIA has paused its Riyadh service after Houthi attacks on the city's airport that Saudi authorities say killed three people, the Pakistan Airports Authority confirmed, adding that other Saudi routes run normally and dismissing social media rumours. No resumption date was given, and Europe's aviation safety agency has widened its no-fly advisory over the region.
